colors.$comment: #rrggbb; one per line (the original) or separated by commas

scene.$comment: JSON written by the authoring mode, the original's format: [{"p":[x,y,z],"c":rgb}], a cube 50 wide, its centre at 25 + 50·n; empty: start with nothing

targetShape.$comment: JSON in the same format: the shape Scoring.find looks for in the building (any of four turns); the response gets "score": 1 when found, 0 when not; empty: no score

label.en: The target shape must match in colour too
label.nl: De doelvorm moet ook in kleur kloppen

label.en: Colour that marks empty space in the target shape (#rrggbb, optional)
label.nl: Kleur voor lege ruimte in de doelvorm (#rrggbb, optioneel)
